test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

He will be made President by the people.

options.text: People will be making him the President.
The people will make him President.
By the people, he shall be made the President.
He will be made President by the people.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of** the active voice sentence** becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is:** "He will be made President by the people."**
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject** "the people"** at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form** "will be made" **to the active verb form** "will make."**
 
• Place the object **"him"** after the verb.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** ***"The people will make him President."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "People will be making him the President." – Incorrect tense; uses future continuous which is not needed for this sentence.
 
• **Option 3:** "By the people, he shall be made the President." – Incorrect word order; remains passive.
 
• **Option 4:** "He will be made President by the people." – This is the original passive voice sentence.
